description: Delete the walls and wall facets associated with zone joints. All associated data structures are deleted.
notes: Documented in the 'wad' (wall-and-discontinuity) doc tree, not under flac3d/ -- which is why this family is absent from the FLAC zone corpus.
Parsed from the installed 9.7 wad doc tree; command presence confirmed on live MPoint3D 9.7 (same 9.0 zone kernel). Not probed on a FLAC3D binary.

keywords.name: free-faces
keywords.description: Delete walls and wall facets that are not acting as zone joints (i.e., that have no contacts associated with them).
